<b>Currently unimplemented!</b>

The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is a grave decoration which will provide a bonus to {{Grave Decor}} when placed on a [[grave place]] after a [[corpse]] has been buried there. The number of positive modifiers to {{Graveyard Rating}} a grave can benefit from is based on the number of {{Skull|Red}} and {{Skull|White}}.  A grave's positive score cannot exceed the number of {{Skull|white}} on the corpse buried there, any decorations added beyond that point will have no effect.  For more information on the types of graves and their effects see the [[Graveyard]]'s location page. 

Installing or uninstalling a grave decoration will take 5-10{{Energy}}.
